title: Energy-Based Transfer for Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2506.16590v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Reinforcement learning remains sample inefficient, particularly when agents must adapt over time to related but distinct tasks, as in continual learning settings. Efficiency can be improved by transferring knowledge from a pretrained teacher policy to guide exploration in new but related tasks. However, if the new task sufficiently differs from the teacher's training task, the transferred guidance may be sub-optimal and bias exploration toward low-reward behaviors. We propose an energy-based transfer learning method that uses out-of-distribution detection to selectively issue guidance, enabling the teacher to intervene only in states within its training distribution. We theoretically link energy scores to state-visitation patterns under on-policy reinforcement learning. Empirically, our method improves sample efficiency and performance across both single-task and multi-task settings.

translated_title: 基于能量的强化学习迁移方法
translated_abstract: 强化学习仍然存在样本效率低下的问题，尤其是当智能体必须随时间适应相关但不同的任务时，例如在持续学习场景中。通过将知识从预训练的教师策略迁移过来，以引导智能体在新但相关的任务中进行探索，可以提高效率。然而，如果新任务与教师策略的训练任务差异足够大，迁移过来的引导可能是次优的，并会使探索偏向低回报的行为。我们提出了一种基于能量的迁移学习方法，该方法利用分布外检测来选择性地发出引导，使教师策略仅在其训练分布内的状态下进行干预。我们从理论上将能量分数与在线策略强化学习下的状态访问模式联系起来。实验表明，我们的方法在单任务和多任务设置中都提升了样本效率和性能。
tldr: 提出一种基于能量分数与分布外检测的迁移学习方法，让教师策略仅在其训练分布内的状态上进行干预引导，从而在单任务和多任务强化学习中显著提升样本效率与性能。
en_tdlr: An energy-based transfer learning method leverages out-of-distribution detection to selectively issue teacher guidance only in in-distribution states, improving sample efficiency and performance across single-task and multi-task reinforcement learning.
